column1: Justification: Hydraulic and cooling water package for the press line upgrade.

column10: Double acting hydraulic cylinder aluminium 6061 for the press line clamp. Working pressure 160 bar minimum. Supply with rod seal kit and test certificate.
Motor for the press line hydraulic power pack. IE3 efficiency class minimum. IP55 enclosure. Foot mounted B3. Supply test certificate and nameplate data.
Full bore ball valve DN25 bronze C83600 flanged to ASME B16.5 Class 150 for the press line cooling circuit. Lever operated. Anti static stem.
Globe valve DN205 bronze rising stem for throttling duty on the cooling water return. Class 150 flanged. Hydrostatic test certificate required for each valve.
Spherical roller bearing 36mm bronze cage for the press line jackshaft. Supply in sealed packaging with anti corrosion protection and batch traceability.
Butt weld long radius elbow 90 degree 50NB SS 304 to ASTM A403 WP304. Schedule 40 wall to match the connecting pipe. Certificate EN 10204 3.1 required.
Drill bit 22mm high speed steel for the maintenance workshop. Supply in protective sleeves. Manufacturer test certificate acceptable in place of EN 10204.
Spiral wound gasket 18mm NBR filler with stainless winding for ASME B16.5 Class 150 flanges on the hydraulic cooler. Shelf life at least 24 months from despatch.
